rules.name: Repeat a stable identity anchor
rules.enforcement: Compile one concise identity anchor from approved character truth and repeat it unchanged; approved references remain visual authority.

rules.name: Keep identity sheets neutral
rules.enforcement: Identity sheets use a simple background and neutral even lighting; transient scene effects and story state require separate references.

rules.name: Carry one visual-language anchor
rules.enforcement: Preserve the approved palette, lighting language, lens character, texture or grain, camera language, and aspect ratio across derived visuals.

rules.name: Compile high-signal prompts
rules.enforcement: Use concrete production direction and short action beats. Never ship unresolved placeholders, editorial commentary, repeated prose, or vague filler.

rules.name: Storyboard Grid preserves continuous scene logic
rules.enforcement: An enabled 3x3 Storyboard Grid contains nine ordered beats derived from the Shot Planner and preserves identity, geography, lighting, staging, screen direction, and temporal flow; it never replaces the Shot Planner.

rules.name: Give each distinct reference one unique upload position
rules.enforcement: Never map multiple distinct references to the same temporary platform position or @Image number; permanent Project Image numbers never change.

rules.name: Separate identity, storyboard, and text authority
rules.enforcement: Character sheets control identity, the Storyboard Grid controls motion/framing/geography, and text controls action, timing, performance, camera, dialogue, sound, and ending state.

rules.name: Version all provider-specific limits
rules.enforcement: Duration, reference capacity, audio behavior, feature support, and syntax must come from the selected versioned Platform Profile, never a global guide snapshot.
